state_snapshot.overall_goal: Develop and harden the FamilyGuard Android app to provide robust parental controls, including remote screen locking, specific app protection, persistent background operation, and remote management of child apps.
state_snapshot.key_knowledge: - **Icon Sharing**: App icons are converted to 64x64 Base64 PNG thumbnails to stay within Firestore document size limits while providing visual identification in the dashboard. - **Lock All Feature**: Optimized batch processing using `addLockedApps` and `removeLockedApps` in `AppLockPrefs` to minimize disk I/O and prevent UI stutters. - **Search Implementation**: Real-time filtering in both `MainActivity` and `DeviceAppsActivity` now includes "No apps found" UI feedback for better user experience. - **Persistence**: Relies on `SyncWorker`, `GuardService`, and high-priority FCM pings for reliable remote command execution.
state_snapshot.file_system_state: - **MODIFIED**: `app/src/main/java/com/familyguard/utils/AppLockPrefs.kt` - Added batch operation methods for app locking. - **MODIFIED**: `app/src/main/java/com/familyguard/service/GuardService.kt` - Updated `CMD_LOCK_ALL_NON_SYSTEM` to use batch methods. - **MODIFIED**: `app/src/main/java/com/familyguard/ui/MainActivity.kt` & `DeviceAppsActivity.kt` - Integrated empty state visibility for search. - **MODIFIED**: `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml` & `activity_device_apps.xml` - Added empty state `TextView` for search results. - **MODIFIED**: `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` - Added localized strings for empty states.
